Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.0005 of 2024, under Section 363, 366, 376(3)
IPC & Section 5(j)(ii)/6 of POCSO Act, P.S. Payagpur, District Bahraich.
3. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report alleging that the daughter of the informant was enticed by the applicant.
The age of the victim was disclosed as 14 years.
Subsequently, in the two statements, the victim did not disclose the prosecution story.
In her statement, she disclosed her age as 17 years.
The victim was tested positive for pregnancy.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant states that the applicant and the victim had gone out of their own freewill and the applicant undertakes to register the marriage on being enlarged on bail.

5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the undertaking and the two statements of the victim not supporting the prosecution,
the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Dhananjay be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
8.
It is provided that the applicant shall take steps to get the marriage registered within a period of six months on being released from jail.
9. In case the applicant resiles from his undertaking to get the marriage registered, the victim would be at liberty to file a bail cancellation application.
